newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ekran said to announce rights results.
newsitem.headline: Ekran said to announce rights results.

text.p: Ekran Bhd's stock suspension could be linked to an expected announcement about its rights offering, equity dealers said on Tuesday.
The main promoter of the $6.2 billion ringgit Bakun dam had set a rights issue of 257.14 milion shares on a one-for-one basis at 5.70 ringgit a share.
The deadline for announcing the issue's results was on Monday. Ekran had expected to raise about 1.5 billion ringgit from the issue.
Ekran's stock was suspended on Tuesday for a company announcement. Its officials could not be reached for comment.
"It probably has to do with the rights issue," said a dealer at a local brokerage firm, adding, "I wouldn't be surprised to see an undersubscription."

The issue is speculated to be as much as 50 percent undersubscribed because of a weak Malaysian stock market and concerns over the Bakun dam project, which is being built in the jungles of Sarawak state on Borneo island.
Dealers said they expected Ekran to make the announcement about its rights issue following the close of trading on Tuesday.
Ekran's stock closed down 15 cents to 5.50 ringgit on Monday.
